summary: Perma-Fix Environmental Services filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a common stock offering under an existing shelf registration. The filing states an offering of an unspecified number of shares at a public offering price to be determined; the last sale price on Nasdaq was $9.70 on May 13, 2026. The company has granted the underwriter, Craig-Hallum, a 30-day option to purchase additional shares. Use of proceeds, specific terms, and final pricing are still to be set. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation event.
